claim: If you have an AWS account, your AWS Health Dashboard shows both public events and account-specific events; the AWS Health Dashboard – Service health website only shows public events, which are not specific to any account, and you do not need to sign in or have an account to view it.

evidence.quote: If you have an AWS account, your AWS Health Dashboard shows both *public* events and *account-specific* events.

If you don't have an account, you can use the AWS Health Dashboard – Service health at [https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status](https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status) to view public events.
This website only shows public events, which aren’t specific to any account. You don't need to sign in or have an account to view this page.
